Interfaces are attached one at a time by csrx/launch.sh — docker does not guarantee attach order, and cSRX maps eth0/1/2 positionally.
Addressing comes from TRUST_PREFIX / MGMT_PREFIX / UNTRUST_PREFIX in .env; the values shown are the defaults.
